thread:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: staged-release-2026-03-15 -> alert 'service.outbound_5xx_rate > 0.5% (5m)'. Link: https://monitoring.internal/redwood/alerts/AR-8321

pagerbot: PD incident created: RDW-INC-2026-83 · Auto-page sent to oncall (Sanjay). Incident URL: https://pagerduty.company/incidents/RDW-INC-2026-83

Sanjay: got the page, I'm on it. Marking as responder taking lead. Can someone drop the canary tag for staged-release?

Lena: seeing spike in 502/503 from the staged cluster (staged-eu-3). Rolling p95 latency from 120ms -> 1.4s, 5xx up to ~3% on canary shards. Logs show repeated: `backend: grpc read: EOF` and `model-serving: kvcache miss + decode error`.

Marco: any traffic % for canary?

Lena: ~15% of traffic routed to staged-release group (policy: gradual 15%).

Sanjay: ok that's enough to impact a few customers. I want a quick rollback to previous image and pause rollout. Plan: 1) Pause feature flag 2) Rollback deployment to image x.y.17 3) Watch health.

Kelly: agree. If rollback is quick we'll avoid paging customers. Amanda, can you take external comms if this hits broader tenants?

amanda: yep, standing by. Will prep status note if escalation needed.

Sanjay: executing pause via FF toggle now.

Sanjay: ```
# flip ff
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN" https://flags.internal/api/toggles/staged-release -d '{"state":"off"}'
```

ops-bot: Feature flag toggle acknowledged by deployment-controller; traffic diversion to baseline scheduled.

Lena: traffic to staged pool dropping from 15% -> 2% within 30s. 5xx still visible but trending down. However some pods in staged-eu-3 are repeatedly crashing (OOM?) with logs containing `runtime: out of memory` and `quant-kernel: cuda mem alloc failed`.

Marco: if there's OOMs we should rollback image — might be a build with different quant config. Sanjay, do you want me to patch the deployment image?

Sanjay: go ahead. Rollback to image redwood/inference:release-2026-03-08 (x.y.17). Use canary label removal + set image.

Marco: running kubectl set image now -> output below.

Marco: ```
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/model-service model-service=redwood/inference:release-2026-03-08 --record
deployment.apps/model-service image updated
```

Marco: also scaling staged pool to 0 for rolling pods: ``kubectl -n inference scale deploy/model-service-staged --replicas=0``

ops-bot: Deployment rollout started; controller reports scaling down staged replicas.

Lena: pods terminating, new baseline pods spin up on baseline cluster. Health probes for baseline show green. p95 back to ~140ms within 90s. 5xx rate falling toward baseline (~0.02%).

pagerbot: PD incident RDW-INC-2026-83 status: acknowledged by Sanjay at T+2m. Update: mitigation in progress.

Sanjay: confirming smoke tests passed (simple generation + embed). Sample request: `curl -s -XPOST https://api.internal/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' | jq '.status'` -> "ok". No 5xx observed locally on baseline.

amanda: we have 2 customer error reports opened via support (acct: acme, beta-corp) for roughly 8-12 minutes around the spike window. I'll hold on public status until we confirm full recovery.

Kelly: good. After rollback we'll keep monitoring 10 more minutes then resolve PD. Assign postmortem to Lena + Marco, timeline + root cause. I'll take severity review.

Lena: quick note about root cause hypothesis: new release included updated quantization kernels (libquant v2) with a subtle cuda mem path change. Under the staged-eu-3 node SKU (A100p-32), memory transient pattern caused allocation failure in warmup sequence causing crash loop + elevated 5xx. Baseline image uses libquant v1. We'll capture core dumps and kernel logs for postmortem.

Sanjay: PD update: mitigation successful, traffic reverted to baseline cluster, canary scaled to 0. I'm going to acknowledge and set incident to resolved once we observe stable metrics for 5m.

ops-bot: Metrics snapshot at T+4m: p50 35ms, p95 135ms, errors 5xx = 0.03% (expected baseline).

pagerbot: RDW-INC-2026-83 resolution proposed by Sanjay: rollback + FF pause. Awaiting confirm to resolve.

Kelly: resolving if metrics stay stable for 5m. Amanda, please publish a short status note: "Mitigated — staged release rollback due to 5xx spike; investigating root cause; no ongoing customer impact."

amanda: drafting now. Will post to status.redwood.ai and ping sales.

Sanjay: resolving PD incident. Thanks everyone. Good catch on the quant path, Lena.

Lena: saving logs + core dumps to /incidents/RDW-INC-2026-83/artifacts and starting postmortem doc. I'll include reproduction steps and kernel traces.

Marco: leaving a short runbook update: note to add an explicit memory smoke step for quant kernel changes, and a flag to limit staged rollout to 5% until X days after release.

ops-bot: Incident closed in PD by Sanjay at T+12m.

pagerbot: RDW-INC-2026-83 -> resolved. Root cause: suspect quant-kernel memory regression in release-2026-03-15. Postmortem assigned: Lena, Marco.

Sanjay: thanks all. Follow-up: postmortem draft in #incidents/postmortems in 24h. :thumbsup:

Kelly: great job, quick rollback and comms. We'll review deployment gating next week. :white_check_mark:
